scope: Two original guarded update/scale bodies connected natively to existing morph/copy: full 16MiB RAM, registers/SR/PR/PC, both FPU banks/FPSCR/FPUL/MACL and ordered entries. Independent data algorithms validate narrow finite updates and scale smoothing.
limitations: Constructed records; natural scheduling and drawing are separate unfinished dependencies.
Wide transfers/PR modes, enabled/reserved arithmetic and invalid RAM are checked as reached partial-state guards, not hardware exception delivery.
Independent update checks stop at the morph boundary; morph output is covered by full original-state comparisons and its earlier independent proof.
